responsibility: Declares the basic-block abstraction used by the gm2 middle end to partition quadruple ranges into reachable single-entry/single-exit regions. The interface initializes block lists from a scope block or explicit quad range, frees them, and iterates over start/end quad pairs, serving as the public contract between quad-level optimization logic and later translation back into optimized quads or GCC trees.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public interface for the M2BasicBlock pair: it declares the opaque BasicBlock type plus the initialization, destruction, and iteration procedures used by later passes. Unlike M2BasicBlock.mod, it does not define the circular block list or the quad-scanning rules that discover leaders and discard unreachable quads.
